run_nms_2d: run 2D non-maximum suppression on axis-aligned bounding boxes with an overlap threshold
run_nms_2d_faster: run faster vectorized 2D non-maximum suppression on bounding boxes using IoU or overlap ratio
run_nms_3d_faster: run faster vectorized 3D non-maximum suppression on axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes
run_nms_3d_faster_samecls: run 3D non-maximum suppression that only suppresses boxes of the same class
run_nms_crnr_dist: run non-maximum suppression using bounding box corner distance measure instead of IoU
